question: Does frozen GDI pretraining improve real TUG prediction on the same Toronto walking intervals?
primary_contrast: C_GDI_features_Ridge versus A_basic_Ridge; compare both with A_basic_RF before any adoption claim
input: One visually fixed frontal approach per person, native124frames, unchanged BODY25->2x124x12 GDI preprocessing; source FPS28..30, actual spans4.1..4.393sec; no duplication or angle-to-pixel conversion
quality: Frozen required-coordinate missingness<=25%; all tracks manually reviewed before any cohort GDI inference; exclusions common to all conditions and no score-driven replacement windows
target: Actual participant TUG seconds from original Toronto Table1, exact agreement with existing audited Toronto input; no GDI ground truth is assumed
split: Reuse original12-person outer fold assignments; inner3-fold people KFold shuffle seed20261031, all choices training-only. If quality exclusions break folds, stop and report rather than silently change split
A: 72 summary features: mean,std,mean absolute frame difference of same12 GDI input features for both legs; Ridge alpha[1,100], RF128trees leaf[2,5]. These are image-space joint summaries, not calibrated m/s
B: A72 plus left/right calibrated GDI predictions averaged over five fixed source folds; same Ridge grid
C: A72 plus ten penultimate activations per leg per GDI fold, concatenate100 (neurons not aligned across folds); same Ridge grid
E_control: A72 plus same100 activations from five randomly initialized frozen copies, seeds20261031..20261035; same Ridge grid
D: Same GdiCNN architecture, independent random initialization, output0 mean across legs predicts standardized TUG; five seeds20261031..20261035. Training-only channel/target normalization, AdamW lr0.001 decay0.001, max80epochs patience12, inner3fold best-epoch median then refit. Report individual seeds and their prediction ensemble. GDI initialization never used

provenance: Separate Toronto and Gillette source cohorts; no shared participant identifier available across sources. Do not claim a cross-dataset identity match audit beyond available provenance
aggregation: One interval and one actual clinical label per person; no repeat-count inflation
metrics: person MAE,RMSE,bias,per-person predictions; TUG>=20sec descriptive subgroup. Paired person bootstrap10000 seed20261031 conditional on fitted predictions, not full uncertainty of model selection; source12 cohort has only one slow case
gates: source member CRC/SHA; frame/target QA; original CPU versus GPU+official-decoder coordinate tolerance0.01pixel on first5 reference frames; frozen API and feature reconstruction tolerance1e-5; scalar CPU checkpoint replay tolerance1e-5sec; fitted inputs/scalers/person splits hashed and audited
